text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it consistently. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and some stretching. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work from home, so I take short breaks every hour to stay focused. In the afternoon, I always exercise for about thirty minutes, either going for a run or doing a workout at home. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I go to bed before eleven because staying consistent helps me feel energetic and organised every day.
